exposure: oral misoprostol solution (20 micrograms every 2nd hourly)
cohort: The study included 80 women at term requiring induction of labour.
finding: Oral misoprostol solution resulted in a shorter induction-delivery interval and less oxytocin augmentation compared to vaginal misoprostol.
mod_finding: Oral misoprostol group had 82.5% spontaneous vaginal deliveries and 12.5% cesarean sections, while the vaginal group had 75% spontaneous vaginal deliveries and 10% cesarean sections.
